crime: On earlier evenings in the lounge, {WITCH_NAME} used her Magic to make herself a child again. The girl cradled her on her lap and sang her a lullaby. Today, the girl recorded the lullaby on a phone and offered it as a substitute for keeping {WITCH_NAME} company at bedtime. {WITCH_NAME} stopped the playback and asked her to sing it again in person.

Even so, the girl accompanied her on a walk by the lake. Rather than let that company end, {WITCH_NAME} used her Magic to turn the girl into a toddler. She held the toddler's head beneath the water. While the girl lay unconscious beneath the water but was still alive, {WITCH_NAME} restored her to adolescence, then kept her submerged until she died.

The prisoners later found the girl's adolescent body face-down on the muddy bank and assumed she had fallen into the lake and drowned by accident. Then they uncovered palm tracks: continuous finger furrows ran from toddler-sized handprints into adolescent ones. The unbroken trail showed that {WITCH_NAME} had returned the girl to adolescence to make the drowning look like an accidental fall.
fields.epitaph: The voice returned at last; her companion never would.
fields.epithet: Mourner of Goodbyes Yet to Come
execution: The execution stand locks her lengthwise against a music-box drum. The drum turns, drawing her body across a steel comb. As it mangles her, the drum plays the girl's lullaby. When the last note fades, her body lies motionless against the drum.

magic.name: Age Shifting
magic.text: She can change any living thing to whatever biological age she chooses.
